description: General mirror-pair Coulomb sign-correction. The per-generator brane-tower has an inverted Z-ordering (predicts the proton-richer mirror member MORE bound). Wiring two fit-free changes — composite pair-knot replacement (removes the spurious E₀·Δtower≈1.165 MeV over-count, restores Z↔N Markov isospin symmetry) + an explicit Z(Z−1)/2 Coulomb term (C(Z,2) proton pairs × the DERIVED per-pair reduction ratio·B_pp, def:coulomb-charge, ratio=tanh(ln q₀); count is combinatorics, magnitude cited from charge-coulomb-tn3he-derived) — restores the correct ordering for EVERY mirror pair with no per-atom retuning. SIGN closed (derived+combinatorial, no fit); MAGNITUDE open (A=3: 31%, residual is the forbidden-to-fit EM-linking invariant). EXPLORATORY; closes the sign bug, not the magnitude.

parameters.per_pair_unit_note: ratio·B_pp; B_pp is the A=3 H_6 diproton bond, used as a uniform per-pair estimate for A>3 (A>3 rows are right-SIGN predictions only)

assertions.name: per_pair_coulomb_consistent_with_cited
assertions.note: ratio·B_pp reproduces charge_coulomb_tn3he_derived dHe to 2.11e-17 (cited, not re-derived)

assertions.name: mirror_ordering_sign_correct_all_pairs
assertions.note: Z(Z−1)/2 Coulomb reduces the proton-richer member for every mirror pair → correct ordering, no per-atom retuning
